Consideration is an essential element of any valid contract, and without it the
agreement fails. The defendant filed a motion for summary judgment, arguing that
no genuine issue of material fact remained.

The patient presented with an acute abdomen and was admitted for observation.
Informed consent was obtained prior to the procedure.

The trustee holds the property subject to an equitable interest in favour of the
beneficiaries. Consideration of the beneficiaries' interests must precede any
distribution.

The security interest was perfected by filing. The negligence claim was barred by
the statute of limitations.

The court will remand the case for further consideration of the damages award.

Consideration is an essential element of any valid contract, and without it the
agreement fails. The defendant filed a motion for summary judgment, arguing that
no genuine issue of **important information** remained.

The patient presented with an acute abdomen and was admitted for observation.
Informed consent was **get** **before** the procedure.

The trustee holds the property subject to an equitable interest in favour of the
**person who receives the benefit**. Consideration of the **person who receives the benefit**' interests must precede any
distribution.

The security interest was perfected by filing. The negligence claim was barred by
the **law** of limitations.
